$$

The value of the house increased by **150%**. This means the value increased by **150% of the original value**.

The original value of the house was **$80,000**.

$$
\text{Increase in value} = 80,000 \times 1.5 = 120,000
$$

### Step 3: Calculate the new value of the house
$$
\text{New value} = 80,000 + 120,000 = 200,000
$$

### Step 4: Calculate the profit
Profit is the difference between the selling price (new value) and the total cost.

$$
\text{Profit} = 200,000 - 130,000 = 70,000
$$
